chunks: And Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated from Safwan from Yazid ibn Khalifah who said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saw me circumambulating around the Ka'bah while I was wearing a burdun (a type of cloak), so he said to me after that: 'I have seen you circumambulating around the Ka'bah while wearing a burdun; do not wear it while circumambulating, for it is from the attire of the Jews.'
And there is no harm if a man drinks water while he is circumambulating. He narrated that.

key_terms.بُرْطُلَةٌ: A type of cloak or outer garment

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on wearing specific clothing or drinking water during Tawaf?
ai.summary: Imam Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) instructed a companion not to wear a 'burdun' (a specific cloak) while performing tawaf around the Ka'bah because it was distinctive attire of the Jews. The narration also clarifies that it is permissible for a person to drink water while in the state of circumambulating.
